label: Sample Consultation Follow-up
instructions: Judge the conversation at its end. Distinguish completed guidance from completed business processing. A customer's future booking is not an outstanding staff obligation. A promise does not prove execution. Select unknown when evidence is missing. Do not infer dates or identities from masked content.

inquiry_type.label: Inquiry Type
inquiry_type.instructions: Select the main purpose of this consultation.

criteria.facility: Facilities, visits, programs, opening hours or access guidance.
criteria.other: Another purpose or insufficient evidence to identify the main purpose.

handling_status.label: Handling Status
handling_status.instructions: What is the status at the end of this conversation?

criteria.guidance_complete: Requested guidance or service is complete and no specific follow-up obligation remains.
criteria.customer_pending: Further processing awaits a specific customer submission or action.
criteria.staff_pending: Staff or a department owes a promised callback, dispatch, check or other action.
criteria.unknown: The conversation does not establish the final status.

follow_up_owner.label: Follow-up Owner
follow_up_owner.instructions: Who owns the next outstanding action?

criteria.customer: The customer must take the next action.
criteria.agent: The consultation agent must take the next action.
criteria.department: A responsible department must take the next action.
criteria.unknown: Ownership cannot be determined from the conversation.

urgency.label: Urgency
urgency.instructions: Rate intervention urgency using explicit harm or time constraints; missing evidence alone is not urgency.
criteria: Low: routine guidance with no urgent harm or deadline.
Medium: follow-up needed without immediate harm or deadline.
High: explicit imminent deadline or significant ongoing impact.
Critical: immediate threat to safety or severe ongoing harm.

follow_up_required.label: Follow-up Required
follow_up_required.instructions: Does the organization owe an unresolved action such as a promised callback, document dispatch or departmental check? Customer actions alone do not count.
